- **[l4d\_achievement\_trophy](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d_achievement_trophy)**: Displays the TF2 trophy when a player unlocks an achievement or kill tank/witch

  - 場上有人擊殺Tank或是Witch時，頭上顯示華麗的獎盃特效
- **[cge\_l4d2\_deathcheck](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/cge_l4d2_deathcheck)**: Prevents mission loss(Round\_End) until all human players have died.

  - 場上所有真人倖存者+AI bots死亡才會回合結束
- **[l4d\_tanklimit](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d_tanklimit)**: limit tank in server

  - 在場上的Tank數量有限制，超過便處死
- **[l4d2\_Death\_Survivor](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d2_Death_Survivor)**: If a player die as a survivor, this model character(Nick/Ellis/Bill/Zoey...) keep death until campaign change or server shutdown

  - 該角色死亡之後，相同模型的角色(Nick/Ellis/Bill/Zoey...)會一直保持死亡，直到更換大地圖或是伺服器重啟
- **[clear\_dead\_body](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/clear_dead_body)**: Remove Dead Body Entity

  - 倖存者死亡之後過一段時間，移除屍體
- **[kills](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/kills)**: show statistics of surviviors (kill S.I, C.I. and FF)on round end

  - 擊殺殭屍與特殊感染者統計
- **[clear\_weapon\_drop](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/clear_weapon_drop)**: Remove drop weapon + remove upgradepack when used

  - 如果一段時間後沒有人撿起掉落的武器與物品，則自動移除
- **[no-rushing](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/no-rushing)**: Prevents Rushers From Rushing Then Teleports Them Back To Their Teammates.

  - 離隊伍太遠的玩家會傳送回隊伍之中
- **[l4dmultislots](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4dmultislots)**: Allows additional survivor players in server when 5+ player joins the server

  - 創造5位以上倖存者遊玩伺服器
- **[savechat](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/savechat)**: Records player chat messages to a file.

  - 紀錄玩家的聊天紀錄到文件裡
- **[l4dinfectedbots](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4dinfectedbots)**: Spawns multi infected bots in any mode + allows playable special infected in coop/survival + unlock infected slots (10 VS 10 available)

  - 多特感生成插件，倖存者人數越多，生成的特感越多，且不受遊戲特感數量限制 \+ 解除特感隊伍的人數限制 (可達成對抗 10 VS 10 玩法)
- **[l4d2\_spawn\_props](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d2_spawn_props)**: Let admins spawn any kind of objects and saved to cfg

  - 創造屬於自己風格的地圖，製作迷宮與障礙物
- **[l4d\_explosive\_cars](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d_explosive_cars)**: Cars explode after they take some damage

  - 車子爆炸啦!
- **[l4d\_lasertag](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d_lasertag)**: Shows a laser for straight-flying fired projectiles

  - 開槍會有子彈光線
- **[anti-friendly\_fire](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/anti-friendly_fire)**: shoot your teammate = shoot yourself.

  - 隊友黑槍會反彈友傷
- **[l4d\_afk\_commands](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d_afk_commands)**: Adds commands to let the player spectate and join team. (!afk, !survivors, !infected, etc.),but no abuse.

  - 提供多種命令轉換隊伍陣營 (譬如: !afk, !survivors, !infected), 但不可濫用.
- **[l4d\_cso\_zombie\_Regeneration](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d_cso_zombie_Regeneration)**: The zombies have grown stronger, now they are able to heal their injuries by standing still without receiving any damage.

  - 殭屍變得更強大，他們只要站著不動便可以自癒傷勢　(仿CSO惡靈降世 殭屍技能)
- **[l4d\_drop](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d_drop)**: Allows players to drop the weapon they are holding

  - 玩家可自行丟棄手中的武器
- **[l4d\_game\_files\_precacher](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d_game_files_precacher)**: Precaches Game Files To Prevent Crashes. + Prevents late precache of specific models

  - 回合開始播放音樂，使用!music點歌系統，可播放自製的音樂

  - 修復第三人稱下，散彈槍射擊沒有槍聲

- **[l4d2\_bash\_kills](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d2_bash_kills)**: Stop special infected getting bashed to death

  - 特感不會被人類右鍵推到死去
- **[charging\_takedamage\_patch](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/charging_takedamage_patch)**: Makes AI Charger take damage like human SI while charging.

  - 移除AI Charger的衝鋒減傷
- **[rescue\_glow](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/rescue_glow)**: Fixed sometimes glow is invisible when dead survivors appears in rescue closet

  - 修復有時候救援房間沒有看到倖存者的光圈
- **[l4d2\_map\_transitions](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d2_map_transitions)**: Define map transitions to combine campaigns in versus

  - 對抗模式第二回合結束時從地圖A切換成地圖B
- **[Luxs-Model-Changer](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/Luxs-Model-Changer)**: LMC Allows you to use most models with most characters

  - 可以自由變成其他角色或NPC的模組
- **[miuwiki\_autoscar](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/miuwiki_autoscar)**: Full auto mode for SCAR

  - SCAR三連發步槍可以切換成全自動模式
- **[l4d\_save\_weapon\_ammo](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d_save_weapon_ammo)**: Prevent filling the clip when taking the same weapon + save if the amount of weapon ammo is more than vanilla.

  - 撿起相同的武器時不會有滿發的彈夾 \+ 儲存在地上的每個武器的彈藥，撿起來後給予相應的彈藥 (為了應付超出官方指令設定的彈藥)
- **[l4d\_exploit\_dmg\_block](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d_exploit_dmg_block)**: Block exploit damage by player, ex: throw molotov and change team to infected

  - 防止惡意玩家的友軍傷害，譬如: 丟火瓶之後跑去特感隊伍
- **[l4d\_collision\_adjustments](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d_collision_adjustments)**: No collisions to fix a handful of silly collision bugs in l4d

  - 改善一些愚蠢的實體碰撞造成的問題
- **[l4d\_full\_slot\_bot\_replace\_fix](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d_full_slot_bot_replace_fix)**: Fix bugs if not enough slots to spawn bots to take over + Kick Previously human-controlled SI bots

  - 修復伺服器客戶端已滿的狀態下無法生成Bot取代玩家所造成的嚴重問題
- **[\_\[L4D2\]Survivor\_Legs](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/_%5BL4D2%5DSurvivor_Legs)**: Add's Left 4 Dead 1 Style ViewModel Legs

  - 第一人稱可以看到自己的雙腳
- **[l4d\_minigun\_fly\_fix](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d_minigun_fly_fix)**: Fixes a glitch with a minigun that allows players to fly long distances

  - 修復倖存者利用地圖上的機關砲台飛上天空
- **[l4d\_witch\_retreat\_panic\_fix](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d_witch_retreat_panic_fix)**: Fixed the bug that witch cancels retreat and comes back to chase survivor again if game starts panic event

  - 修復Witch撤退之後又馬上重新攻擊倖存者的Bug
- **[l4d2\_ladder\_editor](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d2_ladder_editor)**: Clone and move special infected/survivor ladders.

  - 複製並創造新的特感梯子或倖存者梯子
- **[l4d2\_chainsaw\_fix](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d2_chainsaw_fix)**: Fixed server crash due to chainsaw sound issue in l4d2 linux

  - 修復L4D2 linux系統下電鋸音效導致伺服器崩潰
- **[GetCollideableTriggerTestBox\_Detour](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/GetCollideableTriggerTestBox_Detour)**: Fixing the crash with null pointer dereference in `CM_GetCollideableTriggerTestBox`
  - 修復崩潰 `CM_GetCollideableTriggerTestBox` 涵式內的空指針
- **[Tier\_MemScan\_Detour](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/Tier_MemScan_Detour)**: Temp. walkaround agains wrong mem. address access in `Tier0`, maybe some mem. scan related

  - 修復崩潰 `tier0.dll` 涵式相關記憶體錯誤
- **[SV\_SolidMoved-Fix](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/SV_SolidMoved-Fix)**: Fixing the null pointer dereference in `SV_SolidMoved`
  - 修復崩潰 `SV_SolidMoved` 涵式內的空指針
- **[Fix\_CM\_VCollideForModel\_Detour](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/Fix_CM_VCollideForModel_Detour)**: Fixed server crash caused by zero pointer of model\_t passed to `CM_VCollideForModel` function

  - 修復崩潰: 傳給`CM_VCollideForModel` 涵式內的zero pointer
- **[EnumEntity-Fix](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/EnumEntity-Fix)**: Fix Crash `CTriggerTraceEnum::EnumEntity` null pointer

  - 修正崩潰: `CTriggerTraceEnum::EnumEntity` 涵式內的空指針
- **[TriggerMoved\_Detour](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/TriggerMoved_Detour)**: Fix Crash `CM_TriggerWorldSpaceBounds()` null pointer

  - 修正崩潰: `CM_TriggerWorldSpaceBounds()` 涵式內的空指針
- **[Server\_sub\_101D7CB0\_Detour](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/Server_sub_101D7CB0_Detour)**: Fix Crash `server.dll + 0x1d7cbb` null pointer

  - 修正崩潰: `server.dll + 0x1d7cbb` 涵式內的空指針
- **[IsReachable\_Detour](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/IsReachable_Detour)**: Fixing null pointer dereference when it call `SurvivorBot::IsReachable` with NULL argument

  - 修正崩潰: `SurvivorBot::IsReachable` 涵式內的空指針
- **[l4d\_witch\_bash\_wandering](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d_witch_bash_wandering)**: Fixed that survivors can bash wandering witch without witch being startled

  - 修復倖存者推開站立的witch不會導致驚嚇
- **[l4d2\_gascan\_flame\_fix](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d2_gascan_flame_fix)**: Fixed unable to ignite gascan sometimes due to poorly written official code

  - 修復汽油桶有時候無法被火焰點燃
- **[l4d2\_trigger\_flow\_fix](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d2_trigger_flow_fix)**: Prevents custom maps from softlocking due to a poorly filter\_activator\_model's logic when playing with different survivor models

  - 修復不同模組的倖存者在三方地圖啟動地圖上的機關會出現問題
- **[l4d2\_vocalizebasedmodel](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d2_vocalizebasedmodel)**: Survivors will vocalize based on their model + Fixes conversation stucks when playing with l4d1+2 survivor models in custom maps

  - 倖存者根據自身模組發出對應的角色語音+修復不同模組的倖存者在三方地圖無法出現語音劇情對話
- ~~**[l4d2\_transition\_forward](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d2_transition_forward)**: (Archived) Provides forward to determine player inventory transitioned entities between map~~
  - ~~(棄案) 輔助插件，可以知道從上一關玩家物品欄攜帶過來的武器實體~~
- **[l4d\_tank\_pass](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d_tank_pass)**: Allows the Tank to pass control to another player.

  - 允許Tank轉移控制權給隊友
- **[l4d2\_survivor\_mourn\_fix](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d2_survivor_mourn_fix)**: Fixes the bug where any survivor is unable to mourn a L4D1 survivor on the L4D2 set

  - 修復一代倖存者互相看見屍體時沒有語音反應
- **[l4d2\_team\_kill\_reactions](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d2_team_kill_reactions)**: Implements unused TeamKillAccident reaction lines for all 8 survivors

  - 玩家TK導致隊友倒地或死亡，能有更多的角色語音互動
- **[l4d\_versus\_waitforfinalefix](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d_versus_waitforfinalefix)**: Fixing ghost infected spawn bug "Waiting For the finale to begin"

  - 修復靈魂特感無法復活的bug "Waiting For the finale to begin"
- **[l4d2\_max\_health](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d2_max_health)**: Custom maximum survivor health

  - 自定義生還者最大血量
- **[l4d\_reserve\_ammo\_control](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d_reserve_ammo_control)**: Individually control each weapons's reserve ammo

  - 控制每一種武器的後備彈藥數量 (手槍除外)
- **[l4d\_cutscene\_nodamage](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d_cutscene_nodamage)**: Survivors won't take any damage when server is playing map cutscenes

  - 播放地圖的過場動畫時，倖存者不會受傷
- **[l4d\_ghost\_spawn\_exploit](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d_ghost_spawn_exploit)**: Fix exploit where ghost infected player can spawn and teleport to survivor at the same time

  - 禁止靈魂特感玩家利用遊戲漏洞，瞬間傳送在倖存者臉上復活
- **[l4d\_both\_fixChainsaw](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d_both_fixChainsaw)**: Fixed an issue where Survivors could use the chainsaw while reviving a teammate at the same time

  - 修正倖存者救人期間可以同時使用電鋸攻擊
- **[l4d\_both\_ledge](https://github.com/fbef0102/L4D1_2-Plugins/blob/master/l4d_both_ledge)**: When revived from a ledge, you recover the health you had before hanging the ledge

  - 掛邊的玩家被救起來之後，血量恢復到掛邊之前的狀態

/\*\*

\\* L4D2\_skill\_detect

\*

\\* Plugin to detect and forward reports about 'skill'-actions,

\\* such as skeets, crowns, levels, dp's.

\\* Works in campaign and versus modes.

\*

\\* m\_isAttemptingToPounce can only be trusted for

\\* AI hunters -- for human hunters this gets cleared

\\* instantly on taking killing damage

\*

\\* Shotgun skeets and teamskeets are only counted if the

\\* added up damage to pounce\_interrupt is done by shotguns

\\* only. 'Skeeting' chipped hunters shouldn't count, IMO.

\*

\\* This performs global forward calls to:

\\* OnSkeet( survivor, hunter )

\\* OnSkeetMelee( survivor, hunter )

\\* OnSkeetGL( survivor, hunter )

\\* OnSkeetSniper( survivor, hunter )

\\* OnSkeetHurt( survivor, hunter, damage, isOverkill )

\\* OnSkeetMeleeHurt( survivor, hunter, damage, isOverkill )

\\* OnSkeetSniperHurt( survivor, hunter, damage, isOverkill )

\\* OnHunterDeadstop( survivor, hunter )

\\* OnBoomerPop( survivor, boomer, shoveCount, Float:timeAlive )

\\* OnChargerLevel( survivor, charger )

\\* OnChargerLevelHurt( survivor, charger, damage )

\\* OnWitchCrown( survivor, damage )

\\* OnWitchCrownHurt( survivor, damage, chipdamage )

\\* OnTongueCut( survivor, smoker )

\\* OnSmokerSelfClear( survivor, smoker, withShove )

\\* OnTankRockSkeeted( survivor, tank )

\\* OnTankRockEaten( tank, survivor )

\\* OnHunterHighPounce( hunter, victim, actualDamage, Float:calculatedDamage, Float:height, bool:bReportedHigh, bool:bPlayerIncapped )

\\* OnJockeyHighPounce( jockey, victim, Float:height, bool:bReportedHigh )

\\* OnDeathCharge( charger, victim, Float: height, Float: distance, wasCarried )

\\* OnSpecialShoved( survivor, infected, zombieClass )

\\* OnSpecialClear( clearer, pinner, pinvictim, zombieClass, Float:timeA, Float:timeB, withShove )

\\* OnBoomerVomitLanded( boomer, amount )

\\* OnBunnyHopStreak( survivor, streak, Float:maxVelocity )

\\* OnCarAlarmTriggered( survivor, infected, reason )

\*

\\* OnDeathChargeAssist( assister, charger, victim ) \[ not done yet \]

\\* OnBHop( player, isInfected, speed, streak ) \[ not done yet \]

\*

\\* Where survivor == -2 if it was a team effort, -1 or 0 if unknown or invalid client.

\\* damage is the amount of damage done (that didn't add up to skeeting damage),

\\* and isOverkill indicates whether the shot would've been a skeet if the hunter

\\* had not been chipped.

\*

\\* @author Tabun

\\* @libraryname skill\_detect

\*/

#pragmasemicolon 1

#pragmanewdecls required

#include<colors>

#include<left4dhooks>

#include<sdkhooks>

#include<sdktools>

#include<sourcemod>

#define PLUGIN\_VERSION "1.1.3"

#define SHOTGUN\_BLAST\_TIME 0.1

#define POUNCE\_CHECK\_TIME 0.1

#define HOP\_CHECK\_TIME 0.1

#define HOPEND\_CHECK\_TIME 0.1// after streak end (potentially) detected, to check for realz?

#define SHOVE\_TIME 0.05

#define MAX\_CHARGE\_TIME 12.0// maximum time to pass before charge checking ends

#define CHARGE\_CHECK\_TIME 0.25// check interval for survivors flying from impacts

#define CHARGE\_END\_CHECK 2.5// after client hits ground after getting impact-charged: when to check whether it was a death

#define CHARGE\_END\_RECHECK 3.0// safeguard wait to recheck on someone getting incapped out of bounds

#define VOMIT\_DURATION\_TIME 2.25// how long the boomer vomit stream lasts -- when to check for boom count

#define ROCK\_CHECK\_TIME 0.34// how long to wait after rock entity is destroyed before checking for skeet/eat (high to avoid lag issues)

#define CARALARM\_MIN\_TIME 0.11// maximum time after touch/shot => alarm to connect the two events (test this for LAG)

#define WITCH\_CHECK\_TIME 0.1// time to wait before checking for witch crown after shoots fired

#define WITCH\_DELETE\_TIME 0.15// time to wait before deleting entry from witch trie after entity is destroyed

#define MIN\_DC\_TRIGGER\_DMG 300// minimum amount a 'trigger' / drown must do before counted as a death action

/\*

Reports:

 --------

Damage shown is damage done in the last shot/slash. So for crowns, this means

that the 'damage' value is one shotgun blast

Quirks:

 -------

Does not report people cutting smoker tongues that target players other

than themselves. Could be done, but would require (too much) tracking.

Actual damage done, on Hunter DPs, is low when the survivor gets incapped

by (a fraction of) the total pounce damage.

Fake Damage

 -----------

Hiding of fake damage has the following consequences:

\- Drawcrowns are less likely to be registered: if a witch takes too

much chip before the crowning shot, the final shot will be considered

as doing too little damage for a crown (even if it would have been a crown

had the witch had more health).

\- Charger levels are harder to get on chipped chargers. Any charger that

has taken (600 - 390 =) 210 damage or more cannot be leveled (even if

the melee swing would've killed the charger (1559 damage) if it'd have

had full health).

I strongly recommend leaving fakedamage visible: it will offer more feedback on

the survivor's action and reward survivors doing (what would be) full crowns and

levels on chipped targets.

stockintGetSurvivorTempHealth(intclient)

{

floatfHealthBuffer=GetEntPropFloat(client, Prop\_Send, "m\_healthBuffer");

floatfHealthBufferDuration=GetGameTime() -GetEntPropFloat(client, Prop\_Send, "m\_healthBufferTime");

intiTempHp=RoundToCeil(fHealthBuffer- (fHealthBufferDuration\*g\_hCvarPainPillsDecayRate.FloatValue)) -1;

}

stockintShiftTankThrower()

{

inttank=-1;

if (!g\_iRocksBeingThrownCount)

return-1;

tank=g\_iRocksBeingThrown\[0\];

// shift the tank array downwards, if there are more than 1 throwers

if (g\_iRocksBeingThrownCount>1)

{

for (intx=1; x<=g\_iRocksBeingThrownCount; x++)

{

g\_iRocksBeingThrown\[x-1\] =g\_iRocksBeingThrown\[x\];

}

}

g\_iRocksBeingThrownCount--;

returntank;

}

{

returnStrEqual(strClassName, "witch");

}

}

This is the latest multislots with my additional code merged

You can control the number of bots at the start of the round by specifying "l4d\_default\_num\_of\_survivors" in the config. (As know, it's actually controlled by "MaxSurvivors" - "number of players" :3)

↑default value is "4"

This cvar value can be set beyond the Max Survivors value, but if it is set beyond it, the number of bots will be controlled with "MaxSurvivors" as the maximum value.

For example, this is useful when want to set Max Survivors to 8 but want to advance the round with 6 initial players including players and bots.(so, don't want to add extra bots, or other, etc.)

Subscribe to both workshop addons above.

Create a lobby.

Launch the game by clicking the "Start The Game" button now located below the chat box.

### [IronWarrior](https://mgftw.com/members/ironwarrior.252/) _MG Donor_









> Hi there!
>
> Got more suggestions for the L4D2 servers, some might work for L4D, but never tested or looked into too much.
>
> But these are all pretty good, prepare for a long read!
>
> **Incapped Crawling Animation**
>
> [http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=137381](http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=137381)
>
> Since crawling is enabled on the L4D1/2 servers, what about adding this fix?
>
> **No Witch Hunting**
>
> [http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=110617](http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=110617)
>
> This is a nice plugin, when a Witch attacks a player, they go Black and White.
>
> **Crowned Horde**
>
> [http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=111958](http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=111958)
>
> Nice plugin, alerts the horde when the witch is killed.
>
> **Mighty Stomp Foot**
>
> [http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=127339](http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=127339)
>
> This is a really nice plugin which allows Survivors to "walk over" and "kill" common infected who fall flat face on the floor, so you walk over them instead of being blocked.
>
> More realistic then, it's a passive.
>
> **Tank Roar**
>
> [http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=126919](http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=126919)
>
> Gives the Tank a third attack, it can roar/screem and knock/damage players around it.
>
> Below is cvars that I found balanced and have used in servers.
>
> **Witch Control**
>
> [http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=125591](http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=125591)
>
> Awesome plugin that allows Infected players to control the Witch in game, they can stand her up, sit her down, move her, climb ladders, jump and "release" to attack.
>
> This is a big hit for players, really makes the witch deadly since you can move her around.
>
> /note... might be broken due to the last update, need to comfirm.
>
> **Jockey Pounce Damage**
>
> [http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=126153](http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=126153)
>
> This is a plugin that I asked to be made in AMods, it's allows a Jockey to do "pounce damage" if it falls from high up and lands on a Survivor, makes sense, if something falls on you, it's going to hurt.
>
> I listed some cvars below for a balanced and fair server.
>
> **Player unstick**
>
> [http://forums.alliedmods.net/showpost.p ... stcount=66](http://forums.alliedmods.net/showpost.php?p=1233672&postcount=66)
>
> Could this be added to all servers? It allows players to "unstick" themselves if they get stuck to a map object, it does work, it only moves them if they are stuck and not on a ledge or anything. Real useful player command.
>
> **Player teleport**
>
> [http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=114393](http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=114393)
>
> I found this to be a really good tool for "ADMIN's" to use if X or Y ever reason they need to goto a player or teleport a player to them, like if they get stuck in someway or somehow warp out the map, these things don't happen too often, but it's useful to have a command like this if a admin is present. Though, admins need to be reminded that this is not to be abused.
>
> **Final Ghost Range Mod**
>
> [http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=117939](http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=117939)
>
> Spawn distances for Infected players in final maps are beyond crazy, you gotta be miles away from Survivors to spawn, this plugin fixs that, I find the cvar set to 50 really nice.
>
> **Infected Ghost Everywhere**

> [http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=97002](http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=97002)
>
> This allows Infected players to "rotate" through Survivor players to choose who to spawn too, this allows you to quickly move to the rushers or the players in the far back.
>
> **Hide HUD on Vomit**
>
> [http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=84926](http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=84926)
>
> Simple enough, if you are vomited upon by a Boomer, you lose the entire HUD, so you can't see who is down and HP of players, this also has a annoying habit of blocking sourcemod menus if boomed.
>
> **Chainsaw Refuelling**
>
> [http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=121983](http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=121983)
>
> This is a awesome plugin, it allows a player to use a fuel/gas can to refuel the chainsaw instead of it going empty. You refuel it like you was refuelling the car. It's awesome.
>
> For some reason, it's been moved to the unapprove area, but don't know why, it has ALWAYS worked on every SM/MM version release since V10 made it. Never had problems, never. I can't comment on the new update through, but it's been through the Passing Update and worked.
>
> **Explosive Ammo Enable**
>
> [http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=130804](http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=130804)
>
> In Valve's wisdom and to the idiotic system of their voting system if anyone remembered, Explosive Ammo packs was removed from VS, even through everyone voted for "Nothing" and somehow even thruogh Explosive Ammo was 3rd, it still got removed. Crazy maths there.
>
> What this plugin does, is change one or x amount of Incendiary Ammo pack into one Explosive Ammo, I think that is fair, no harm in one pack.
>
> **Uncommon Boomer Bile**
>
> [http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=128372](http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=128372)
>
> This is a plugin that I requested to be made to allow Uncommon Infected hordes to be called upon a Boomer's vomit, pretty cool and the cvars allow total control for balance reasons.
>
> **Gear Transfer 1.4.2**
>
> [http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=137616](http://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=137616)
>
> This is a cool plugin that allows you to trade almost any item with other Surviors. Really useful for true teamplayers.
>
> Well, thank you for reading this long post and if you took the time to check out the plugins at the links.
>
> If you have any questions, please ask. I have used all these plugins over in SimianCage, other then the new Gear Transfer 1.4.2 So I pretty know them inside and out.







[IronWarrior](https://mgftw.com/members/ironwarrior.252/), [Oct 11, 2010](https://mgftw.com/threads/l4d2-plugins-suggestions.246/ "Permalink")



[#1](https://mgftw.com/threads/l4d2-plugins-suggestions.246/ "Permalink")

2. [![HonorCode](https://mgftw.com/styles/mg/xenforo/avatars/avatar_m.png)](https://mgftw.com/members/honorcode.112/)



### [HonorCode](https://mgftw.com/members/honorcode.112/) _Head Administrator_ _**Staff Member**_









> Re: L4D2 plugins suggestions!
>
> **Incapped Crawling Animation**
>
> I tested it once and it didn't work so well. But that was on the first release, i'll give it a shot.
>
> **No Witch Hunting**
>
> That would be a bit overpowered for infected. We are adding alot of custom and long paths and survivors will bareally make it to the safe room.
>
> **Crowned Horde**
>
> I'm pretty sure Vicious Infected does the same, but could work for L4D1
>
> **Mighty Stomp Foot**
>
> +1 for this one ![:)](https://mgftw.com/styles/mg/xenforo/fok/smile.gif).
>
> **Tank Roar**
>
> I think this would be a good option, but not on all servers (Not in Berserker Mode for example).
>
> **Witch Control**
>
> I'm not sure if it will run bug-less with 10 infected around.
>
> **Jockey Pounce Damage**
>
> This one would rock ![:D](https://mgftw.com/styles/mg/xenforo/fok/biggrin.gif).
>
> **Player unstick**
>
> It could be easily exploited, im to sure.
>
> **Player teleport**
>
> Custom commands have a similar functionallity i think.
>
> **Final Ghost Range Mod**
>
> +1 for Dark Carnival
>
> **Infected Ghost Everywhere**
>
> Ghostfly is fast enough to reach survivors IMO.
>
> **Hide HUD on Vomit**
>
> I used this once, its a good plugin.
>
> **Chainsaw Refuelling**
>
> I don't think anybody would actually use this feature.
>
> **Explosive Ammo Enable**
>
> This one please! ![:D](https://mgftw.com/styles/mg/xenforo/fok/biggrin.gif)
>
> **Uncommon Boomer Bile**
>
> The bitch slap makes boomer overpowered enough xD.
>
> **Gear Transfer 1.4.2**
>
> I'm not sure about this one. I can give it a shot on the test server.
>
> Thanks for the suggestion, nice collection of plugins you've got there ![:)](https://mgftw.com/styles/mg/xenforo/fok/smile.gif).







[HonorCode](https://mgftw.com/members/honorcode.112/), [Oct 11, 2010](https://mgftw.com/threads/l4d2-plugins-suggestions.246/#post-7233 "Permalink")



[#2](https://mgftw.com/threads/l4d2-plugins-suggestions.246/#post-7233 "Permalink")

### [marvel](https://mgftw.com/members/marvel.1/) _Head Administrator_ _**Staff Member**_









> Re: L4D2 plugins suggestions!
>
> Some could be added yes, but more plugins is more code is more lag is more restarts /crashes ![;)](https://mgftw.com/styles/mg/xenforo/fok/wink.gif)

### SuperBunny _Guest_









> Re: L4D2 plugins suggestions!
>
> with the new DLC still just being out, we need to give it a while, its still very buggy, honesly we already have a ton of plugins already on each server.
>
> But ofcouse yea, every now and again, i do try something new, but userly just on PP

> Re: L4D2 plugins suggestions!
>
> Well, I checked our plugin count compared to other servers and on average we have like 10 - 15 plugins less. However, the admins with more plugins have more crashes as well.
>
> I always want to add only plugins that we really can't live without, like zombie character selecte, moving smoker, pounce announce etc.
>
> But incapped crawling animation, I could care less if that one is enabled or not. It's not worth the risk of extra crashes. There are however some other usefull plugins between them, but none of them are a really great addition to any of the servers.
>
> So yeah I agree with you, let's just leave it running like this and continue working on current projects (like coop) and don't dive into new adventures just yet ![:)](https://mgftw.com/styles/mg/xenforo/fok/smile.gif)

1. Download `multicolors.zip`.

There are only 6 colors supported in l4d1/2, not like other source game

| Color Tag | Color | Description |
| --- | :-: | :-: |
| {default} | default white | \\x01 |
| {green} | olive | \\x04 |
| {olive} | green | \\x05 |
| {lightgreen} | light green | \\x03 |
| {red} | red | There must be at least one player or bot in infected team，or red will turn into olive color |
| {blue} | blue | There must be at least one player or bot in survivor team，or blue will turn into olive color |

Caution

2 of (Blue, Red, Lightgreen) colors can not be used together in one sentence

* * *

1. 下載 `multicolors.zip`
2. 放到 `addons/sourcemod/scripting` 相同資料夾，如果有詢問覆蓋則直接按"是"

在L4D1/2中，只支援六種顏色，不像其他的Source遊戲支援很多種

| 顏色對應表 | 顏色 | 說明 |
| --- | :-: | :-: |
| {default} | 預設的白色 | \\x01 |
| {green} | 橘色 | \\x04 |
| {olive} | 綠色 | \\x05 |
| {lightgreen} | 淺綠色 | \\x03 |
| {red} | 紅色 | 特感隊伍要有人或bot在才會顯示紅色，否則顯示橘色 |
| {blue} | 藍色 | 倖存者隊伍要有人或bot在才會顯示藍色，否則顯示橘色 |

Caution

注意事項: 藍色, 紅色, 淺綠色，這三種顏色的其中任意兩種不可出現在同一句話裡

This item has been added to your [Favorites](https://steamcommunity.com/my/myworkshopfiles/?section=guides&browsefilter=myfavorites).

![](https://community.fastly.steamstatic.com/public/images/sharedfiles/ico_dialogue_close.png)

Information

Simulate L4D2's **gamemodes.txt**, but as a file handled via plugin for L4D1.

This is the successor to my [Competitive-Bots+ for L4D1](https://steamcommunity.com/groups/Dead4Mods/discussions/0/1620599015882346401/). This now allows users to create and modify their preferred bot ConVars with ease.

\*\*Initially posted in **[Dead 4 Mods](https://steamcommunity.com/groups/Dead4Mods/discussions/0/3413181885094372027/)**

Can be used in game client and server

Prerequisites

- [Download](https://www.sourcemod.net/downloads.php)\[www.sourcemod.net\] and install Sourcemod

- [Download](https://www.sourcemm.net/downloads.php?branch=stable)\[www.sourcemm.net\] and install Metamod

- [Download](https://www.sourcemm.net/vdf)\[www.sourcemm.net\] and install Game VDF

- Set -insecure launch options in steam

How to do all of this metamod/sourcemod stuff? You can follow this Youtube tutorial:

P.S. Be sure to make yourself admin in sourcemod

Installation

Step 1: Build or download pre-built binaries

As the user, you have two choices here:

- Build the latest **l4d\_botconfigloader.sp** [file](https://forums.alliedmods.net/attachment.php?attachmentid=197074&d=1664124066)\[forums.alliedmods.net\] to .smx format.

- [Download](https://www.sourcemod.net/vbcompiler.php?file_id=197074)\[www.sourcemod.net\] the latest \*.smx file.

Original [link](https://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=338462)\[forums.alliedmods.net\] to Alliedmodders thread.

Once obtained or compiled, place the "l4d\_botconfigloader.smx" in the ff. directory:

..\\addons\\sourcemod\\plugins

I.E. If using a windows game client, the directory structure would look like this:

📁Local Disk (C:)
└📁Program Files (x86)
⠀└📁Steam
⠀⠀└📁steamapps
⠀⠀⠀└📁common
⠀⠀⠀⠀└📁left 4 dead
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀└📁left4dead
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀└📁addons
└📁sourcemod
└📁plugins
└📄l4d\_botconfigloader.smx

Step 2: Download or Create your own "BCL" (Bot Configuration Loader File)

You can create your own BCL\_CFG file named **L4D\_BCL.cfg**, but it should have the ff. content:

"GameModes"
{
"coop"
{
//Insert your custom ConVars Below this line for coop/campaign/single player mode
}
"versus"
{
//Insert your custom ConVars Below this line for versus mode
}
"survival"
{
//Insert your custom ConVars Below this line for survival mode
}
}

Or you can download CB+ BCL\_CFG files. You will find 3 versions

- [CB+ CFG Collection](https://forums.alliedmods.net/attachment.php?attachmentid=195811&d=1658161829)\[forums.alliedmods.net\]

As for the description of each BCL\_CFG, you may refer to below:

- CB+ Main CFG - Basically CB+ Survivor Edition CFG & CB+ Apocalypse Edition CFG combined into **ONE** convenient package. **Choose this if you desire a balanced challenge**

- CB+ Survivor Edition CFG - Enhances all the survivor bots **ONLY**. **Choose this if you prefer having better teammates instead.**

- CB+ Apocalypse Edition CFG - Enhances all infected AI. If you are **SADISTIC** and want to suffer more, you may choose this instead. **Best used by veterans or well-experienced players who don't care about survivor bots or plainly dislike survivor bots**

Step 3: Load your BCL\_CFG file

For loading BCL\_CFG files, please place the CFG of your choice into the ff. directory:

..\\addons\\sourcemod\\configs

I.E. If using a windows game client, the directory structure would look like this:

📁Local Disk (C:)
└📁Program Files (x86)
⠀└📁Steam
⠀⠀└📁steamapps
⠀⠀⠀└📁common
⠀⠀⠀⠀└📁left 4 dead
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀└📁left4dead
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀└📁addons
└📁sourcemod
└📁configs
└📄L4D\_BCL.cfg

END: Congratulations!

The configurations you place inside the file should print onto the server console.

Make sure you pair the ConVars with the appropriate key values or else the problematic lines will prevent you from using them.

It should look like this:

[![](https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1875202458376767296/846115FBC8494802A6F96E92EC55CD06C7512E35/)](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2830883600&insideModal=1)

P.S. Extra Bot Features and delicious gibs (if there are any)!

In the event that you'd like to tweak the bots further or just fixing the game in general, you may combine this plugin with the ff.:

- **[\[L4D & L4D2\] Bots Ignore PipeBombs and Shoot (2.0) \[28-Sep-2021\]](https://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=333464)\[forums.alliedmods.net\]**

**INFO:** Fixes a bug wherein the bots don't shoot while a pipebomb is currently ticking down after being thrown.

- **[\[L4D1 & L4D2\] Survivor AI Pounced Fix Improved version 1.2.2](https://forums.alliedmods.net/showpost.php?p=2784647&postcount=88)\[forums.alliedmods.net\]**

**INFO:** If a survivor is pinned, the closest bot with a direct line of sight to the attacker/dominator will aim and fire at the target dominator. The bots can also save themselves from a smoker tongue grab

- **[\[L4D & L4D2\]Physics Object Pushfix\[Left 4 Fix\]](https://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=325263)\[forums.alliedmods.net\]**

**INFO:** Prevents firework crates, gascans, oxygen and propane tanks being pushed when players walk into them.

- **[\[L4D\] Survivor Spawn Position Fix](https://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=338572)\[forums.alliedmods.net\]**

**INFO:** Fixes a weird bug wherein bots or players spawn outside of the map leading to their untimely demise. **Best used in custom campaigns.**

- **[\[L4D & L4D2\] Special Exploit Fixes](https://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=334580)\[forums.alliedmods.net\]**

**INFO:** Prevents players from taking advantage of the afk exploits when dealing with boomers, witches, and tanks.

- **[\[L4D & L4D2\] Stuck Zombie Melee Fix](https://forums.alliedmods.net/showpost.php?p=2674716&postcount=35)\[forums.alliedmods.net\]**

**INFO:** Fixes the zeds from being stuck ducking, floating, or else not stagger-able.

- **[\[L4D/L4D2\] Vigilant Tank Behavior \| 0.1 : October 13, 2021](https://forums.alliedmods.net/showthread.php?t=334690)\[forums.alliedmods.net\]**

**INFO:** Alters the Tank's default behavior of being put in idle state after spawning recently to one similar in finales, making him charge towards the survivors instantly instead. **NOT RECOMMENDED IN COMPETITIVE MODES SUCH AS VERSUS**

# [L4D2 Survivor Bot Jump Fix - SourceMod Plugin](https://www.youtube.com/watch?app=desktop&v=JpgH7oofr9s)

**Visibility**: Public
**Uploaded by**: [Justin Chellah](https://www.youtube.com/@Justin_Chellah)
**Uploaded at**: 2024-01-27
**Published at**: 
**Length**: 00:32
**Views**: 35
**Likes**: 1
**Category**: Gaming

## Description

```
I developed this plugin to address a problem where survivor bots often failed to jump on "ledges" (obstacles) across many maps. This issue frustrated players because it made bots easy targets for the infected team, especially on certain maps. Additionally, the bots would frequently teleport to free themselves, which was unconventional in a PvP game mode.

Video Chapters
0:00 Demo of the bug
0:14 Loading up the plugin
0:23 Demo of the fix

Source Code
https://github.com/justin-chellah/survivor-bot-jump-fix

Website & Socials
https://justin-chellah.com
https://github.com/justin-chellah
```
